column1: # The repositories of the large-monorepo soak (docs/hardening.md), each pinned to a commit so an
# upstream push cannot move a run. Move a pin deliberately, in its own commit.
# Columns (tab-separated): name, clone URL, commit, fetch depth (a number: a shell `read` drops an empty tab-separated field),
# worktree paths. The main checkout is whole; each added worktree checks out only these
# comma-separated directories (plus the root files), because twenty whole copies of a 150 000-file
# tree do not fit a CI runner's disk. The soak fails when a worktree holds fewer than
# --min-worktree-files files, so a path that moved upstream is caught, not soaked empty.
